reason: The text explicitly portrays the Israelites as followers of YHWH (Yahweh) through multiple indicators: (1) The people cry out to YHWH in their fear ('וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־ יְהוָה'); (2) Moses directs them to witness YHWH's salvation ('אֶת־ יְשׁוּעַת יְהוָה'); (3) The narrative describes YHWH fighting for them ('יְהוָה יִלָּחֵם לָכֶם'); (4) Most explicitly, the passage concludes: 'וַיִּירְאוּ הָעָם אֶת־ יְהוָה וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בַּיהוָה' (the people feared YHWH and believed in YHWH). The entire narrative demonstrates the Israelites' dependence on, reverence toward, and faith in YHWH as their God and deliverer.
